en.headline: Yellow fire danger warning issued again on a dry, hot Sunday
en.dek: The Observatory said the fire risk is high after issuing the warning at 6am, as an anticyclone keeps southern China mainly fine.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow fire danger warning at 6am on Sunday, saying the fire risk is high. The warning is the second in two days after a similar signal was posted on Saturday morning.

An anticyclone aloft is bringing generally fine weather to southern China, the Observatory said in its 9-day forecast updated at midnight. Sunday is expected to stay mainly fine, dry and very hot during the day, with temperatures of about 28 to 33 degrees and east to northeast winds of force 2 to 3, becoming cloudy with isolated showers later.

Hikers and country-park visitors were reminded not to light fires outside designated barbecue sites and to extinguish cigarettes completely. Dry ground after several hot, largely rain-free days raises the chance of hill fires spreading quickly.

The Observatory said a broad trough of low pressure may bring unsettled weather to seas east of the Philippines later in the week, while Tropical Cyclone Dujuan is moving across waters south of Japan and is not expected to affect Hong Kong directly.

zh.headline: 天文台再發黃色火災危險警告 周日乾燥酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台今早6時發出黃色火災危險警告，指火警風險頗高；高空反氣旋令華南大致天晴。
body: 香港天文台今日上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示現時火災危險性頗高。這是連續第二日發出同類警告，昨日早上亦曾掛出黃色火災危險警告。
天文台午夜更新的九天天氣預報指，高空反氣旋正為華南帶來普遍晴朗天氣。今日大致天晴，日間乾燥及酷熱，氣溫約28至33度，吹東至東北風2至3級，稍後轉多雲，局部地區有驟雨。
當局提醒郊遊人士不要在指定燒烤場地以外生火，煙蒂須徹底弄熄。連日炎熱少雨，地面乾燥，山火一旦發生較易蔓延。
天文台表示，本周中後期一道廣闊低壓槽會為菲律賓以東至南海中部海域帶來不穩定天氣；熱帶氣旋杜鵑正移過日本以南海域，預料不會直接影響本港。
